heroHeadline: Palestinian Killed in Settler Raid on Hajja as Second Palestinian Shot Dead Near Qusra; ICJ Opens Hearings on Germany's Gaza Genocide-Complicity Case
heroSubtitle: Overnight into September 7, 2026, roughly nine armed settlers raided Hajja village in the northern West Bank; when residents rushed to confront them, IDF troops arrived from the opposite direction, trapping Palestinians between soldiers and settlers who both opened fire, killing 20-year-old Omar al-Tubasi and wounding three others. In a separate incident near Qusra, a Palestinian stabbed and critically wounded a 20-year-old Israeli settler before a military commander shot him dead. Prime Minister Netanyahu said Israel would 'continue to eliminate terrorists.' The same day, the ICJ opened four days of hearings on Germany's bid to dismiss Nicaragua's case alleging Germany is complicit in genocide in Gaza through continued arms exports to Israel and defunding of UNRWA. In Gaza on September 6, Israeli strikes killed 4 Palestinians in Gaza City: a vehicle strike killed Youssef Akila and his 8-year-old daughter Wafaa (6 wounded, IDF said it targeted a Hamas militant), a strike near a telecommunications facility killed a man, and tank fire on a school sheltering displaced families killed a 3-year-old boy. The cumulative Palestinian death toll in Gaza since October 7, 2023 now exceeds 73,474+, with more than 1,344 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect.
